summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder was charged a 215 EUR no-show fee and disputes that the charge is valid.
summary.to_defend: Mastercard requires the merchant to show the original booking, the no-show/cancellation policy disclosed at booking, evidence the cardholder failed to show or cancelled outside the window, and that the fee charged matches that policy.

requirements.finding: The booking confirmation identifies reference MSP-2025-4488 for guest K. Adler, booked 12 March 2025 for a one night stay on 26 April 2025 at 215.00 EUR on Mastercard ending 4421, matching the disputed amount and card.

requirements.title: Policy disclosed at booking
requirements.text: The merchant's no-show / cancellation policy as disclosed at booking.
requirements.finding: The cancellation policy states the non-refundable rate is charged in full at booking with no refund for no-show, and records tick-box acceptance by the guest on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET with consent_id cns_4488a, the same date as the booking.

requirements.title: No-show or late cancellation
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder either failed to show or cancelled outside the policy window.
requirements.finding: The front desk log for booking MSP-2025-4488 records the guest as expected at 15:00 on 26 April 2025, not arrived and no contact at 22:00, and formally marked NO-SHOW at the midnight cut-off.

justification: Represent: R1 to R4 are all satisfied, with R3 decisive as the front desk log records the guest as a no-show for booking MSP-2025-4488 on 26 April 2025.
rationale:
The cardholder booked a non-refundable Classic Double for one night on 26 April 2025 under reference MSP-2025-4488 at 215.00 EUR on the Mastercard ending 4421.
The non-refundable policy, stating no refund for cancellation or no-show, was accepted by tick-box consent on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET (consent_id cns_4488a).
The front desk log records the guest as not arrived and with no contact at 22:00 on 26 April 2025, and marked NO-SHOW at the midnight cut-off.
The amount retained, 215.00 EUR, is exactly the non-refundable rate disclosed and accepted at booking.
The transaction was 3DS authenticated with AVS full match (Y) and CVV match (M), supporting that the cardholder made the booking.
analyst_notes: Confirm with the merchant that only one 215.00 EUR charge exists and reconcile the 12 March 2025 'charged at booking' wording with the 26 April 2025 transaction date before filing.
Ask for the booking page consent record (cns_4488a) if the issuer challenges policy disclosure.
